referenceFunction.generalComment: Data are based on information from a recent European Research project dealing with the recycling / reuse of LCD screens. The total weight is based on an internet survey of 90 different 17-inch LCD screens on the market. In 2023, the inventory is updated using the bill of materials data from Babbiet et al 2020; UUID: a8a1011a-a710-327b-ac1f-27af1d16b5fb
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the various parts of a complete 17-inch computer LCD screen. All further efforts (auxiliaries, energy, emissions, waste, ?) are included in a separate module ? that is linked to this module here.
